en.text:
Upon picking up <special/>Special or <heavy/>Heavy Ammo:
<title Refills [G_refill] /> and Overfills the Magazine from reserves.

Overfill amount maxes out at #e${100+#d}% of the Magazine Capacity. Activates even while stowed.

enhanced (
var d = 20
#e Maximum overfill amount is increased by 20% (rounds up). 
)
